question: Tell me about a project you enjoyed.
text: I enjoyed building a small library website with two classmates. I worked on the API and wrote tests for common errors. One useful moment came when a teammate tried the site and did not understand an error message. I changed the message and tested it again. That experience showed me that good software needs clear communication as well as working code. | I would like to keep learning through practical projects. Feedback helps me find problems I would otherwise miss.
